title: Visit Steven McFellow at the Metro Hub

nodes.speaker: Steven McFellow
nodes.text: You're not my contact.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're not my contact.

nodes.speaker: Steven McFellow
nodes.text: I worry that is not good news for my actual contact?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I worry that is not good news for my actual contact?

nodes.speaker: Steven McFellow
nodes.text: Well, I guess I shouldn't be surprised. It seems like Aspetic's network runs deep. Thank CORA he didn't get his hands on the item.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, I guess I shouldn't be surprised. It seems like Aspetic's network runs deep. Thank CORA he didn't get his hands on the item.

nodes.speaker: Steven McFellow
nodes.text: I find it unlikely that my contact will have dropped something as important as this.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I find it unlikely that my contact will have dropped something as important as this.

nodes.speaker: Steven McFellow
nodes.text: Nothing of any use to you. Hand it over!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Nothing of any use to you. Hand it over!

nodes.speaker: Steven McFellow
nodes.text: Ok fine. What you have in your hands is this months NATA-log. It is of no use to you so I suggest you hand it over.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ok fine. What you have in your hands is this months NATA-log. It is of no use to you so I suggest you hand it over.

nodes.speaker: Steven McFellow
nodes.text: I obviously have to hide stuff better.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I obviously have to hide stuff better.

nodes.speaker: Steven McFellow
nodes.text: It's my business to survive, so this discussion is over. If you...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's my business to survive, so this discussion is over. If you...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Correct. But I think I have something that is addressed to you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Correct. But I think I have something that is addressed to you.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Correct. But I think I have something that is addressed to you.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Correct. But I think I have something that is addressed to you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yes, I'm sorry but they were murdered by the Aseptic.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes, I'm sorry but they were murdered by the Aseptic.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Yes, I'm sorry but they were murdered by the Aseptic.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Yes, I'm sorry but they were murdered by the Aseptic.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: (Lie) I'm not sure what happened, I just found this.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: (Lie) I'm not sure what happened, I just found this.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: (Lie) I'm not sure what happened, I just found this.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: (Lie) I'm not sure what happened, I just found this.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What is it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What is it?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: If you want the item, you will have to tell me what it is.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If you want the item, you will have to tell me what it is.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: If you want the item, you will have to tell me what it is.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: If you want the item, you will have to tell me what it is.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Maybe I'll just keep it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Maybe I'll just keep it.

nodes.speaker: Steven McFellow
nodes.text: Wow... Ok. I'll try and sum this up in a way you might understand. The entire rail system in Nivalis is run by two very diametrically opposed AIs. The Nivalis Autonomous Transport Authority, or NATA, is an ancient and mad scheduling system that is as old as the cities more crumbled foundations.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Wow... Ok. I'll try and sum this up in a way you might understand. The entire rail system in Nivalis is run by two very diametrically opposed AIs. The Nivalis Autonomous Transport Authority, or NATA, is an ancient and mad scheduling system that is as old as the cities more crumbled foundations.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: And the other AI?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And the other AI?

nodes.speaker: Steven McFellow
nodes.text: The Train Route and Control Knowledge System or TRACKS. This more modern AI deciphers the mad ramblings of NATA into a schedule that humans like you can understand.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The Train Route and Control Knowledge System or TRACKS. This more modern AI deciphers the mad ramblings of NATA into a schedule that humans like you can understand.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why are train schedules so valuable?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why are train schedules so valuable?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Why are train schedules so valuable?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Why are train schedules so valuable?

nodes.speaker: Steven McFellow
nodes.text: Once every four weeks, TRACKS spits out the deciphered schedule called a NATA-Log for the next month and, if you know the right people, they might be able to get their hands on said data before it becomes public knowledge.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Once every four weeks, TRACKS spits out the deciphered schedule called a NATA-Log for the next month and, if you know the right people, they might be able to get their hands on said data before it becomes public knowledge.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: This sounds insane. Why does anyone care?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: This sounds insane. Why does anyone care?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: This sounds insane. Why does anyone care?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: This sounds insane. Why does anyone care?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Wow, what a smart system.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Wow, what a smart system.

nodes.speaker: Steven McFellow
nodes.text: Thing is, you can do a lot with the NATA-log. Find out where peak footfall will be for your new Grime-Soda pop-up. Or something more sinister, like planning a heist or even a murder.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thing is, you can do a lot with the NATA-log. Find out where peak footfall will be for your new Grime-Soda pop-up. Or something more sinister, like planning a heist or even a murder.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: And people steal this data?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And people steal this data?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: My AI mentioned you run a railway blog. Do you know anything about the CrustyPunks?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: My AI mentioned you run a railway blog. Do you know anything about the CrustyPunks?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: My AI mentioned you run a railway blog. Do you know anything about the CrustyPunks?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: My AI mentioned you run a railway blog. Do you know anything about the CrustyPunks?

nodes.speaker: Steven McFellow
nodes.text: Firstly, The Rail-Trail is much more than just a 'blog'. It's a fully realized transportation eco-system with over thirty thousand... you know what? Never mind.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Firstly, The Rail-Trail is much more than just a 'blog'. It's a fully realized transportation eco-system with over thirty thousand... you know what? Never mind.

nodes.speaker: Steven McFellow
nodes.text: Never mind. You wanted Huckstash right? Let me upload the NATA-log Data to my Comm and I'll tell you where he might be.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Never mind. You wanted Huckstash right? Let me upload the NATA-log Data to my Comm and I'll tell you where he might be.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Know where I can find him?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Know where I can find him?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Know where I can find him?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Know where I can find him?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: NATA-Log?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: NATA-Log?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: There you go.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: There you go.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Thank you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thank you.

nodes.speaker: Steven McFellow
nodes.text: Here, take this back. I uploaded it all and I don't want it on me. It's been near a crime scene. I could do without the heat.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Here, take this back. I uploaded it all and I don't want it on me. It's been near a crime scene. I could do without the heat.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Out of interest, why did you want the NATA-log?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Out of interest, why did you want the NATA-log?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Out of interest, why did you want the NATA-log?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Out of interest, why did you want the NATA-log?

nodes.speaker: Steven McFellow
nodes.text: I'm what they call a Ferroequinologist. A studier of the Iron Horse. A frother, a basher. A train-spotter if you will. That log tells me where to be and when.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm what they call a Ferroequinologist. A studier of the Iron Horse. A frother, a basher. A train-spotter if you will. That log tells me where to be and when.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Anything else you can tell me about this Huckstash?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Anything else you can tell me about this Huckstash?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Anything else you can tell me about this Huckstash?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Anything else you can tell me about this Huckstash?

nodes.speaker: Steven McFellow
nodes.text: Huckstash flies under the radar. Always has done. Always been a big figure in the world of railway gangs.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Huckstash flies under the radar. Always has done. Always been a big figure in the world of railway gangs.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Railway gangs?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Railway gangs?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Ok...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ok...

nodes.speaker: Steven McFellow
nodes.text: Jumping on freight trains hoping to find themselves. When these groups organize they become gangs with territories and laws.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Jumping on freight trains hoping to find themselves. When these groups organize they become gangs with territories and laws.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sounds dangerous.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sounds dangerous.

nodes.speaker: Steven McFellow
nodes.text: You should tread carefully around Huckstash. Some say he is the mad veteran of far-away war.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You should tread carefully around Huckstash. Some say he is the mad veteran of far-away war.

nodes.speaker: Steven McFellow
nodes.text: Hold on, you mentioned my blog where did you even find the Rail Trail?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hold on, you mentioned my blog where did you even find the Rail Trail?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: My Automata found it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: My Automata found it.

nodes.speaker: Steven McFellow
nodes.text: Looks like that area will be the least surveilled by CorpSec for the next few weeks.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Looks like that area will be the least surveilled by CorpSec for the next few weeks.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yeah.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah.

nodes.speaker: Steven McFellow
nodes.text: Yes I know the Crusty Punks, rail gang, nasty reputation.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes I know the Crusty Punks, rail gang, nasty reputation.

nodes.speaker: Steven McFellow
nodes.text: Run by a mystery-man with an even more nasty reputation. Goes by Huckstash. I'd be careful if that's who you're looking for.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Run by a mystery-man with an even more nasty reputation. Goes by Huckstash. I'd be careful if that's who you're looking for.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: And?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What do I need to know?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What do I need to know?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What do I need to know?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What do I need to know?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: None of your business, is it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: None of your business, is it?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: None of your business, is it?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: None of your business, is it?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: At least if you want to survive.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: At least if you want to survive.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: At least if you want to survive.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: At least if you want to survive.

nodes.speaker: Steven McFellow
nodes.text: Ahhh I see I see. Yes, I would check the subway station around Meridian Market.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ahhh I see I see. Yes, I would check the subway station around Meridian Market.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That's close by.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's close by.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Meridian Market? You sure?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Meridian Market? You sure?

nodes.speaker: Steven McFellow
nodes.text: Over the years the city has seen many gangs come and go. Normally, it's young vagrants looking to live a life on the tracks.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Over the years the city has seen many gangs come and go. Normally, it's young vagrants looking to live a life on the tracks.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why do they do it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why do they do it?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sounds exciting.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sounds exciting.

nodes.speaker: Steven McFellow
nodes.text: Others say his whole family was killed by Roid-droids. Who knows he could even be... nah. I should shut up.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Others say his whole family was killed by Roid-droids. Who knows he could even be... nah. I should shut up.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Some?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Some?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: And the others?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And the others?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: The Aseptic... Understood.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The Aseptic... Understood.
